# Ritter Strategic Enterprises (RSE)
**Fractional CTO & Infrastructure Architecture**
**Website:** https://ritterstrategic.com

## About Us
RSE provides executive-level Fractional CTO services. We specialize in designing Zero-Trust architecture and Crisis-Resilient physical infrastructure. We don't just optimize software; we harden the physical foundation of a business to ensure aggressive Recovery Time Objectives (RTO).

## Core Competencies
* **Zero-Trust Architecture:** Cryptographic verification for all remote and on-premise workflows.
* **Physical Infrastructure:** Through a 25-year national partnership, we oversee enterprise-grade hardware, low-voltage cabling, and physical security deployments coast-to-coast. RSE acts as the Strategic Liaison.
* **AI Support Transformation:** Deployment of modular agent clusters and autonomous systems (like the RISE agent).

## Engagement Model
We begin all engagements with our **Foundational Tech Audit ($2,950)**, an industrial-grade diagnostic designed to identify single points of failure, consolidate vendor sprawl, and build a "Crisis-Ready" roadmap.
